title: UPMRCL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Various Project Director Posts
description: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation (UPMRCL) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill up the vacancies for Project Director Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering can use this chance and apply for the UPMRCL Recruitment 2026 . Here, we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested candidates can apply on or before the last date of application. ...
